resources.string: Shows where the top of your phone points, even in airplane mode. Uses a little battery only while your position is visible on the map. Stops when hidden or the screen is off. GPS interval stays unchanged.
A low-power compass is unavailable on this phone.
20–30 s suits most trekking. Use 5–10 s for tight switchbacks, or 60 s for a sparser track with fewer fixes. Longer intervals miss bends and delay off-route alerts.
